avis.titre: Flakes off - doesn't play well with other skincare
avis.texte: Grateful I purchased this on sale, I still paid too much and because Ulta's return policy is now only 30 days I'm stuck with it. I have middle age skin that leans dry (thanks, perimenopause!) but is in otherwise very good condition. I've used this product for a solid week by now, and every single time it has caused my skincare to flake off. Like, really badly flake around the hair line, under my chin, around my eyes. I do not find this formula moisturizing. After it dries down, my skin feels just as dry, if not drier, than before. I think this would be a good serum to use alone with microneedling, or if using as skincare it's best suited for those with oily skin. I have seen no improvement in my skin tone or texture, and the flaking, dryness it leaves makes this a hard pass for me.

avis.titre: Not one of my favorite Osea products
avis.texte: The smell is mild, but unpleasant, and I don't love how it goes on or how my skin feels after. For now I'm using the Dream Night serum which is also not as good as the old anti-aging serum but at least it smells good - meanwhile exploring products from other brands, but I have yet to find something that compares to the Osea anti-aging serum.

avis.titre: Three Stars Solo, Five Stars in a Pair
avis.texte: Out with the old. I used La Mer for decades, but in my mid-40s, during perimenopause, Ive become more aware of endocrine disruptors in skincare. I was disappointed to learn that, despite its steep price, La Mer is not a clean brand. As someone who has battled hormonal imbalance and fibroids for years, I assumed premium meant safer ingredients - unfortunately, it didnt. Ive since moved to OSEA This isnt the most hydrating/plumping hyaluronic acid Ive used. For very mature skin like mine, it feels quite basic. I need intense plumping and hydration, and this just didnt deliver. The upside is that when I layer it with the Atmosphere Protection Cream in the day and Advanced Protection Cream at night, the results are far better. I think the creams do most of the heavy lifting for moisture. For me, this is a solid three-star product.
I love this for my evening routine, but I can't use it in the morning because it affects my foundation application (becomes very flaky).
